title: Lifting $L$-polynomials of genus 3 curves
summary: Let $C$ be a smooth plane quartic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$. Costa, Harvey, and Sutherland provide an algorithm with an implementation, improving Harvey's average polynomial-time algorithm, to compute the $\bmod \ p$ reduction of the numerator of the zeta function of $C$ at all $p\leq B$, where $p$ is an odd prime of good reduction, in $O(B\log^{3+o(1)} B)$ time, which is $O(\log^{4+o(1)}p)$ time on average per prime. Alternatively, their algorithm can do this for a single prime $p$ of good reduction in $O(p^{1/2+o(1)})$ time. While this algorithm can be used to compute the full zeta function,…
